sa: तदभून्मुसलं घोरं वज्रकल्पमयोमयम्॥ जघान कृष्णस्तांस्तेन ये ये प्रमुखतोऽभवन्।
en: That handful of grass became a terrible bolt of iron gifted with the energy of the thunderbolt. With it Krishna destroyed all those who came before him.

sa: वृक्षे वृक्षे हि पश्यामि चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरम्। गृहीतधनुषं रामं पाशहस्तमिवान्तकम्॥
en: From that very day I see Rāma wearing bark and deerskin even in the very trees before me like to Death with the noose in his hands.

sa: पश्य द्वैतवने पार्थ ब्राह्मणानां तपस्विनाम्। होमवेलां कुरुश्रेष्ठ सम्प्रज्वलितपावकाम्॥
en: “Behold, O Partha, O Kuru chief, in this forest Dvaita the hour of the ascetic Brahmanas for performing Homa when the (sacred) fires have all been enkindled.

sa: परं लोकं गोप्रदास्त्वाप्नुवन्ति दत्त्वानड्वाहं सूर्यलोकं व्रजन्ति। वासो दत्त्वा चान्द्रमसं तु लोकं दत्त्वा हिरण्यममरत्वमेति॥
en: He who gives away cows (to the Brahmanas here) goes to the highest region. By giving bullocks he goes to the solar region, by giving ciothes he goes to the lunar region and by giving gold he goes to the region of the immortals.

sa: जग्मुः पुरस्कृत्य महानुभावं शतक्रतुं वृत्रहमं नरेन्द्राः। तीर्थानि सर्वाणि परिभ्रमन्तो माध्यां ययुः कौशिकी पुण्यतीर्थाम्॥
en: These foremost of men, headed the great performer of hundred sacrifices, the slayer of Vritra, sojourned to all the sacred waters one after another, and at last reached the highly sacred Kaushiki on the day of the full moon in the month of Magha.

sa: ततस्तामेव संगृह्य शक्तिं कनकभूषणाम्॥ भीमसेनाय चिक्षेप क्रुद्धरूपो विशाम्पते।
en: (And) he (the son of Subala) seized that weapon, adorned with gold and O lord of the universe, hurled it back against Bhimasena with a fierce countenance,

sa: शाखाः पञ्चदशेमास्तु विद्या भास्करदेशिताः। प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथाकामं वेद्यं तदनुचिन्तयम्॥
en: Having established this knowledge consisting of fifty branches which I had acquired from the Sun, I now meditate on the great object of that knowledge (viz., Brahma).

sa: तत्रासीत्सुमहद्युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम्। रक्षसां वानराणां च वीराणां जयमिच्छताम्॥
en: And great and fierce was the engagement that took place between the heroic Rakşasas and monkeys burning for victory, capable of making people's hair stand on end.

sa: अधिभूतं च कर्माणि शक्रस्तत्राधिदैवतम्। वैश्वदेवी तत: पूर्वा वागध्यात्ममिहोच्यते॥
en: As connected with objects, it is actions; and the presiding deity there is Indra. Next, connected with the soul is speech which relates to all the celestials.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा धर्मराजस्तु कृतं सर्वमतन्द्रितः। हृष्टरूपोऽभवद् राजा सह भ्रातृभिरादृतः॥
en: Hearing that everything was ready, king Yudhishthira the just, full of alertness and attention, became highly pleased along with his brothers all of whom honoured him duly.

sa: आत्मप्रच्छादनार्थं वै बाहुवीर्यमुपाश्रितः। विप्ररूपं विधायेदं मन्ये मां प्रतियुध्यसे॥
en: In order to conceal your personality have you assumed the forin of a Brahmana and mastering all the strength of arms are you now fighting with me?

sa: स तथोक्त्वा मुनिजनमरजामिदमब्रवीत्। इहैव वस दुर्मेधे आश्रमे सुसमाहिता॥
en: Having thus addressed the inmates of the hermitage the great saint, said to Arajās. O unfortunate girl, with a devoted mind do you wait at this hermitage.

sa: महता शरवर्षेण पाण्डवं समवाकिरत्। द्रौणिश्चाभ्यद्रवद् राजन् रथमास्थाय फाल्गुनम्॥
en: Surrounded the son of Pandu by a mighty discharge of arrows. The son of Drona too, seated on his car, rushed against Phalguna, the son of Pritha.

sa: नैवं विनष्टाः शोच्यन्ते क्षत्रधर्मव्यवस्थिताः। वृद्धिमाशंसमाना ये निपतन्ति रणाजिरे॥
en: The heroes abiding by the virtues of the kş arriyas, who fall at the battle field for enhancing their glory, when dead, should not be mourned for.

sa: अन्नपानादिवस्त्राणि सर्वोपकरणानि च। भरतः सह शत्रुघ्नो नियुक्तो राजपूजने॥
en: And diverse food, drink and clothes were offered to the kings when they arrived there with profuse presents. Bharata, with Satrughna, engaged in attending upon the kings.

sa: स तु युद्धे महाराज दिनानां दशतीर्दश। हतवाहनभूयिष्ठस्ततो दैन्यमुपागमत्॥
en: King Divodasa fought the enemy for a thousand days at the end of which, having lost a large number of followers and animals, he became greatly distressed.

sa: तथा तु चरतस्तस्य भीमस्य रणमूर्धनि॥ दुर्योधनो महाराज पार्श्वदेशेऽभ्यताडयत्।
en: While Bhima was thus moving about in circles on the field of battle, Duryodhana, O king, suddenly struck him a fierce blow on one of his flanks.

sa: धनुर्वेद गताः पारं मुष्टियुद्धे च कोविदाः। गदायुद्धविशेषज्ञा नियुद्धकुशलास्तथा॥
en: Masters in the art of bowmanship, they are well-skilled in fighting with their fist also. They are skilled in fighting with maces and also in close quarters.

sa: ततः स्नातः शुचिर्भूत्वा कृतकौतुकमङ्गलः। स्नातकानां सहस्त्रस्य स्वर्णनिष्कानथो ददौ॥
en: Then Satyaki, having taken a bath and having purified himself and having under gone every auspicious ceremony gave away to the Snataka Brahmanas thousand of golden Nikshasas.

sa: स मामभ्येत्य समरे तथैवाभिमुखं स्थितम्। शूलपाणिरथोवाच तुष्टोऽस्मीति परंतप॥
en: He with the trident in his hand, coming up to me and seeing me ready for fight, O tormentor of foes, said "I am pleased (with you)."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः सभ्याः कुरुराजस्य तस्य वाक्यं सर्वे प्रशशंसुस्तथोच्चैः। चेलावेधांश्चापि चक्रुर्नदन्तो हाहेत्यासीदपि चैवार्तनादः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing these words of the Kuru king (Duryodhana), all persons present in the assembly loudly applauded him. Some shouting approvingly made signs to one another by motions of their eyes and lips and some made sounds of distress such as "Oh," "Alas."

sa: ततो वयमितस्तूर्णं शूलशक्तिगदाधराः। चापबाणासिहस्ताश्च त्वरितास्तत्र यामहे ॥ आकाशे गणशः स्थित्वा हत्वा तां हरिवाहिनीम्। अश्मशस्त्रमहावृष्ट्या प्रापयाम यमक्षयम्॥
en: Then, equipped with darts, javelins and maces, and bearing bows, arrows and scimitars in our hands, we shall swiftly and summoning speed* set out (from hence); and stationing ourselves in the sky in bands, and slaughtering the monkey-army with mighty showers of rocks and weapons, we shall lead it to Death's door. *Tvarita-summoning speed-redundant.

sa: स महात्मा महात्मानं भीमं भीमपराक्रमः॥ अताडयच्छवदेशे न चचालाचलोपमः।
en: The great and highly powerful Duryodhana, then struck the high-souled Bhimasena on the forehead. The latter, however, stirred not an inch but stood fixed like a mountain.

sa: तच्छुत्वा नृपतिस्तस्य हर्षबाध्याकुलेक्षणः॥ प्रियाख्याननिमित्तं वै ददौ बहुधनं तदा।
en: On receipt of this news, tears of joy covered the king's eyes. Large gifts were made to the messenger for the very sweet tidings he had brought.

sa: जिगीषमाणाः संग्रामे समन्ताद् वैरिणोऽभ्ययुः। अस्त्रयुद्धविदो घोराः सृजन्तश्चाशिवा गिरः॥
en: He simultaneously attacked his enemies who desired to obtain victory over him, who were accomplished in fighting with weapons and who had assaulted him with fierce yells.

sa: अस्मिन्मुहूर्ते गत्वैको निवर्तिष्यामि वानरान्। प्रविष्टान्सागरं भीममम्बरं वा रसातलम्॥
en: This moment marching alone (from hence) will I exterminate the monkeys, even if they shall have entered the dreadful deep, or the sky, or the subterranean regions.

sa: तान्यहं तत्प्रतीघातैरस्त्रैरस्त्राणि भारत। व्यधमं तुमुले युद्धे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा सुदुस्त्यजान्॥
en: Those weapons I met by weapons capable of meeting them, o Bharata, in that terrific struggle, casting off hopes of life which is so hard to sacrifice.

sa: ततस्तु सिंहसेनस्य शिरः कायात् सकुण्डलम्। व्याघ्रदत्तस्य चाक्रम्य भल्लाभ्यामाहरबली॥
en: Then Drona of great prowess putting forth his energy, severed the head of Sinhasena decked with ear-rings also that of Vyaghradatta, with a pair of broad-headed shafis.

sa: एवमभ्यागतस्येह कपोतस्याभयार्थिनः। अप्रदाने परंधर्मं कथं श्येन न पश्यसि॥
en: O hawk, why do you not see that it is a great virtue for me not to give up this pigeon which has thus come to me?

sa: तमाविध्यच्छितैर्बाणैः कङ्कपत्रैर्युधिष्ठिरः। तस्य द्रोणो धनुश्छित्त्वा तं द्रुतं समुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Thereupon Yudhishthira pierced him with shafts, keen-pointed and furnished with feathers of the Kanka bird, Drona also cutting his bow in two charged him with great impctus.

sa: तान् भीमसेनः संक्रुद्धो धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः॥ बलेन चतुरङ्गेण परिक्षिप्याहनच्छरैः।
en: Then Bhimasena, worked up with wrath and Dhrishtadyumna the son of Prishata, encircling those soldiers with the help of four kinds of forces destroyed them with arrows.

sa: द्रष्टुं भागीरथीं गङ्गामुवास बहुलः समाः। यत्रेष्टं सर्वभूतानामीश्वरेण महात्मना॥
en: He lived there for a long period with the desire of seeing the Ganges which is called Bhagirathi (after him). Here the illustrious lord of all creatures.

sa: मार्गमिच्छाम्यहं दत्तं भवता पर्वतोत्तम। दक्षिणामभिगन्तास्मि दिशं कार्येण केनचित्॥
en: "O foremost of mountains, I wish to have a path given to me by you, as I intend to go to the southern country for some purpose.

sa: ससम्भ्रमं ततस्तूर्णमवप्लुत्य रथोत्तमात्। सहदेवो महाराज दृष्ट्वा कर्णं व्यवस्थितम्॥
en: The son of Madri, then, speedily jumping down from his excellent car and burning with indignation, as it were, at the sight of Karna stationed (before him).

sa: तस्याः संश्रुत्यं च वचो देवाश्चाग्निपुरोगमाः। चिन्तयामासुरेकाग्राः शनार्थं राजसत्तम॥
en: Having heard her words, the gods with Agni at their head, began to deliberate earnestly on the means of attaining to Shakra's good, O best among kings.

sa: वयं सिद्धमशिष्यामो भवान् साधयतामिदम्। एवं संवीक्ष्य नियमेन्नाधर्मोऽस्ति कथंचन॥
en: We will eat this cooked food of you. You may cook these raw things (that we give in return). In such an agreement there is no sin.

sa: अन्तरिक्षचरा घोरा महाकाया महाबलाः। रक्ताक्षाः पिङ्गलाक्षाश्च शुक्तिकर्णाः प्रहारिणः॥
en: They were capable of ranging the sky, they were fearful, huge-bodied, and greatly strong; they had blood-like red and coppery eyes and arrowy-ears, they were all well-armed.

sa: ब्राह्मणस्त्रिषु वर्णेषु शस्त्रं गृह्णन दुष्यति। एवमेवात्मनस्त्यागन्नान्यं धर्मं विदुर्जनाः॥
en: The Brahmana, by fighting for the three other castes, does not commit sin. People say that there is no higher duty then renouncing life under such circumstances.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज धनुर्वेदस्य पारगः॥ वधाय युयुधानस्य दिव्यमस्त्रमुदैरयत्।
en: Thereupon, O mighty monarch, that one who had reached the end of all military sciences, being inflamed with wrath invoked into existence a celestial weapon slaughtering Yuyudhana.

sa: पुनः सप्तशतानन्यान् सहस्रं चानिवर्तिनः। चिक्षेपायुतशश्चान्यांस्तेऽनन् द्रोणस्य तां चमूम्॥
en: Once more he shot seven hundred other arrows and again a thousand irresistible arrows and ten thousand other arrows. All these dispatched many warriors of Drona's division.

sa: ब्रह्मक्षत्राविरोधेन पूजां च प्राप्नुयामहम्। यथा ममाक्षया कीर्तिर्भवेच्चापि पुरंदर॥
en: I bow to you by bending my head, O god! You should do that also by which my fame, O Purandara, may live eternally in the world!

sa: नामर्षं तत्र कुर्वन्ति धिक् क्षात्रं धिगमर्षिताम्। पार्थाः सर्वे च राजानः पृथिव्यां ये धनुर्धराः॥
en: When that Drona suffered such an insult at the hands of that most sinful Dhristadyumna under the very eyes of all the warriors present, was there no Kshatriya who was then inspired with wrath? Fie on the Kshatriya order and fie on wrath itself!

sa: अवध्यः सर्वभूतानां बलिश्चापि महासुरः। वामनं वपुराश्रित्य त्रैलोक्याद् भ्रंशितस्त्वया॥
en: There was a great Asura named Bali, incapable of being killed by any crcature. Assuming the form of a dwarf, you exiled him from the three worlds.

sa: अदाता ह्यनतिस्नेहो दण्डेनावर्तयन् प्रजाः। साहसप्रकृती राजा क्षिप्रमेव विनश्यति॥
en: That king, who is illiberal, and shorn of affection, who oppresses his subjects by undue punishment, and who is rash in his acts, soon meets with destruction.

sa: अविज्ञाता महात्मानो जनानामक्षतास्तथा। जनन्या सह कौन्तेया मुक्ता विदुरमन्त्रिताः॥
en: Thus also were the illustrious sons of Kunti with their mother saved by the advice of Vidura; but the people did not know that they were alive.

sa: तेषामिङ्गित्तभावज्ञो विदुरस्तत्त्वदर्शिवान्। आकारेण च तं मन्त्रं बुबुधे दुष्टचेतसाम्॥
en: The wise and learned Vidura, capable of reading the heart (of men) by external signs, came to know from their demeanours the intention of those wicked-minded men.

sa: अलुब्धो मतिमान् ह्रीमान् क्षमावान् रूपवान् बली। वपुष्मान् मानकृद् वीरः प्रियः सत्यपराक्रमः॥ यस्य श्लाघन्ति विबुधाः कर्माण्यूर्जितकर्मणः। निवातकवचाञ्जने कालकेयांश्च वीर्यवान्॥ महेन्द्रशत्रवो येन हिरण्यपुरवासिनः। अक्ष्णोनिमेषमात्रेण पौलोमाः सगणा हताः॥ परेभ्योऽप्यभयार्थिभ्यो यो ददात्यभयं विभुः। तस्यास्माभिर्न शकितस्त्रातुमप्यात्मजो बली॥
en: Arjuna is free from covetousness, intelligent, bashful, forbearing, handsome, powerful, endowed with well-developed limbs, respectful to the elders, heroic, amiable and devoted to truth; the feats of that one of fierce deeds even the gods applaud; that one of puissant energy slew Nivatakavachas and also the Kalakeyas; by him were the opponents of the great Indra, the dwellers of the golden cities, viz., the Paulamas slain with their followers, within the twinkling of any eye; that lord gives assurance of safety to those who seek to be protected from their enemies. Alas, today, we have not been competent through fear, to save the son even of that one!

sa: महानागान् विद्रवतो दृष्ट्वार्जुनशराहतान्। पतितान् पततश्चान्यान् मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Meseems my sons are lamenting beholding the huge elephants of my army fly away smitten by the arrows of Arjuna and also beholding them fallen and falling.

sa: स गङ्गायामुपस्पृश्य पुण्यगन्धि पयः शुचि। तं देशमुपसम्पेदे परमर्षिर्मनोजवः॥
en: Having cleansed himself by the sacred and fresh water of the Ganges, the Great Rishi, capable going everywhere at will as quickly as the mind, came there.

sa: दृष्ट्वा सत्यजिता द्रोणं ग्रस्यमानमिवाहवे। वृकः शरशतैस्तीक्ष्णैः पाञ्चाल्यो द्रोणमार्दयत्॥
en: When the great warrior Vrika saw Satyajit badly gripped within the ambit of arrows shot by Dronacharya, he shot several hundred acute arrows and injured severally Dronacharya.

sa: किर्मीरश्च महातेजा हैडिम्बश्च सखा तदा। स दीर्घकालसध्युषितं पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन्॥
en: So also the highly puissant Krimira and his friend Hidimba. He waited for a long time, keeping alive the memory of his old enmity with the Pandavas.

sa: सर्वायुधसमायुक्तो धन्वी त्वं रथमास्थितः। शरैर्वा यदि वाप्यस्त्रैर्दर्शयस्व पराक्रमम्॥
en: Seated on a chariot and skilled in archery you are equipped with all weapons, therefore, you display your own prowess either with your arrows or with arms.

sa: मेघजालनिभं सैन्यं विदार्य शरवृष्टिभिः। विबभौ कौरवश्रेष्ठः शरदीव दिवाकरः॥
en: The Kaurava hero, piercing the hostile army with showers of arrows looked resplendent like the autumnal Sun when he disperses the clouds with his powerful rays. once

sa: अङ्गास्तु गजवारेण पाण्डवं पर्यवारयन्। क्रुद्धाः सहस्रशो राजशिक्षिता हस्तिसादिनः॥
en: Then thousands of well-trained elephant riders belonging to the divisions of the Angas, excited with rage, O king, surrounded the son of Pandu, with their elephant forces.

sa: कृपश्च रथिनां श्रेष्ठः कौरममितौजसम्। आरोपयद् रथं राजन् दुर्योधनममर्षणम्॥
en: Then that foremost of car-warrior, namely Kripa took upon his own car, O king, the vindictive Duryodhana, that descendant of the Kuru race, endued with immeasurable energy.

sa: संस्तूयमानः सूतैश्च वन्द्यमानश्च बन्दिभिः। उपगीयमानो गन्धर्वैरास्ते स्म कुरुनन्दनः॥
en: That delighter of the Kurus then, was praised by all creatures, the minstrels gratified him with panegyrics; and the Gandharvas then began to sing at his hearing.

sa: अमृष्यमाणस्ताञ्छूरान् दिव्यायुधवरान् स्थितान्॥ अपाण्डवायेति रुषा व्यसृजद् दारुणं वचः।
en: Unable to bear the arrows of the Pandavas and the presence of those wielders of celestial weapons, he cried in anger saying,-For the destruction of the Pandavas.'

sa: ते तमाजन्जिरे वीरं निवातकवचान्तकम्। संशप्तकनिहन्तारं हन्तारं सैन्धवस्य च।॥
en: From every side they began to strike that hero, that destroyer of the Nivatakavachas, that destroyer of the Samsaptakas, that destroyer of the king of the Sindhus.

sa: रथान् द्विपान् हयांश्चैव सारोहानर्जुनो युधि। शरैरनेकसाहौनिन्ये राजन् यमक्षयम्॥
en: O monarch, in that battle Arjuna, sent away innumerable car-warriors, elephants, horses and cavalry to the abode of Death, by striking them with several thousands of arrows.

sa: किंप्रमाणा हयास्तस्य रथकेतुर्धनुस्तथा। कीदृशं वर्म चैवास्य शिरस्त्राणं च कीदृशम्॥ पृष्टस्त्वमेतदाचक्ष्व कुशलो ह्यासि संजय।
en: What was the measure of his horses, his standard and his bow? What kind of armour and head-gear did he then wear? O Sanjaya, expert as you are in the art of narration, tell me all this as I am asking you about them.

sa: एतत्तदुक्तमव्यक्तमक्षरं ब्रह्मसंमितम्। देवानां हृदयं सौम्य गुह्यं रामः परंतपः॥
en: Rāma, the subduer of foes, is the indescribable and undecaying letter Brahmā, which has been described in the Vedas) as the heart and secret of the celestials.

sa: तस्य संदधतस्तीक्ष्णञ्छरांश्चासक्तमस्यतः॥ धनुर्घोषण वित्रस्ताः स्वे परे च तदाभवन्।
en: As Ghatotkacha placed keen shafts on his string and as he let them off, his foes and friends alike became terrified with the twang of his bow.

sa: त्वरमाणोऽभ्ययात् कर्ण भीमं चावारयच्छरैः। दुर्मुखं प्रेक्ष्य संग्रामे सूतपुत्रपदानुगम्॥
en: Quickly rushed to the rescue of Karna, covering at the same time Bhima with his arrows. Beholding Durmukha approach to rescue the son of Suta in battle.

sa: धर्माख्यानेषु सर्वेषु सत्याख्याने च यद् वसु। दशेदमृक्सहस्राणि निर्मथ्यामृतमुद्धतम्॥
en: By churning the riches contained in all religious works and in all topics based on truth, as also the ten thousand Riches, this ambrosia has been acquired.

sa: गोमत्यास्त्वेष पुलिने त्वदर्शनसमुत्सुकः। आसीनो वर्तयन् ब्रह्म ब्राह्मणः संशितव्रतः॥
en: Living on the banks of the Gomati, he is anxiously expecting your return. Of rigid vows, that Brahmana is sitting there, engaged in the recitation of Brahma.

sa: यं च वेदविदो वेद्यं वेदान्ते च प्रतिष्ठितम्। प्राणायामपरा नित्यं यं विशन्ति जपन्ति च॥
en: Persons well read in the Vedas consider you as the one object of knowledge which has been explained in the Vedanta. These men, given to the suppression of vital airs, always meditate on you and at last enter into you as their highest end.

sa: शौचमावश्यकं कृत्वा देवतानां च तर्पणम्। धर्ममाहुर्मनुष्याणामुपस्पृश्य नदी तरेत्॥
en: One should, having finished the necessary rites, perform; his ablutions in river-water and gratify the gods with oblations of water. This is the duty of all men.

sa: ब्रह्मवध्यामिमामद्य भवतः शासनाद् वयम्। ग्रहीष्यामस्त्रिलोकेश मोक्षं चिन्तयतां भवान्॥
en: We are willing, O lord of the three worlds, to take at your order this sin of Brahmancide. May you point out the means of our rescue.

sa: जन्ममृत्युविवादे च तथा विशसनेऽपि च। शुभाशुभमयं सर्वमेतदाहुः क्रियापथम्॥
en: The Soul considers himself as connected with birth and death and quarrels and destruction. All these, the learned say form the path of acts good and bad.

sa: धर्मलक्षणमाख्यातमेतत् ते कुरुसत्तम। तस्मादनार्जवे बुद्धिर्न ते कार्या कथंचन॥
en: The marks of virtue have now been described to you, O best of Kuru's race? Do not, therefore, at any time think of doing a wrong act.

sa: यथेह नियतः कालो दर्शयत्यार्तवान् गुणान्। तद्वद्भूतेष्वहंकारं विद्यात् कर्मप्रवर्तकम्॥
en: As Time, under its own laws, always creates the seasons one after another, so one should know that Consciousness in all creatures is the mover of acts.

sa: श्वित्री क्लीबश्च कुष्ठी च तथा यक्ष्महतश्च यः। अपस्मारी च यश्चान्धो राजन् नार्हन्ति केतनम्॥
en: That Brahmanas who is afflicted with leucoderina, or he who is shorn of generative power, or he who has got leprosy, or he who has got phthisis, or he who suffers from epilepsy, or he who is blind, should not O king, be invited.

sa: जामदग्न्येन रामेण सहस्रनयनोपमः। संयुगे निहतो रोषात् कार्तवीर्यो महाबलः॥
en: Indeed, Karttavirya of great strength, resembling the thousand-eyed Indra himself, on account of his having yielded to anger, was killed in battle by Rama of Jamadagni's race.

sa: अथोपविष्टश्च यदा तस्मिन् भद्रासने तदा। स्नापयामास शनकैस्तमृषि सुखहस्तवत्॥
en: After the Rishi had taken his seat upon it, the old lady began to wash his body with her own soft hands whose touch was highly agrecable.

sa: ज्ञानपूर्वकृतं पापं छादयत्यबहुश्रुतः। नैनं मनुष्याः पश्यन्ति पश्यन्त्येव दिवौकसः॥
en: Only ignorant fools try to conceal the sins which they commit knowingly. It is true that men do not see those sins, but the gods see them.

sa: अस्माकं विहिता वृत्तिः कापोती जातिधर्मतः॥ सान्याय्याऽत्मवता नित्यं त्वद्विधेनानुवर्तितुम्।
en: You are endued with the knowledge of self. You should, therefore, follow that course which has been ordained for us as pigeons on account of our birth.

sa: अहं सर्वत्रगो ब्रह्मन् भूतग्रामान्तरात्मकः। भूतग्रामशरीरेषु नश्यत्सु न नशाम्यहम्॥
en: I pervade all things, O Brahmana, and am the inner Soul of all creatures. When the bodies of all creatures, however, are destroyed, I am not destroyed.

sa: माया ह्येषा मया सृष्टा यन्मां पश्यसि नारद॥ सर्वभूतगुणैर्युक्तं नैव त्वं ज्ञातुमर्हसि। मयैतत् कथितं सम्यक् तव मूर्तिचतुष्टयम्॥
en: What you see of me, ONarada, is merely an illusion of mine. I now appear to be possessed of the attributes of all created things. You are not competent to know me. I have shown to you duly my fourfold form. I am, O Narada, the doer, I am Cause, and I am Effect.

sa: ततो धूपैश्च गन्धैश्च माल्यैरुच्चावचैरपि। बलिभिर्विविधाभिश्च पूजयामास तं द्विजः॥
en: The Brahmana then, having determined thus, adored that Cloud with incense, perfumes and garlands of flowers of the most superior kind, and with various sorts of offerings.

sa: धर्मलक्षणमाख्यातमेतत् ते कुरुसत्तम। तस्मादनार्जवे बुद्धिर्न ते कार्या कथंचन॥
en: The marks of virtue have now been described to you, O best of Kuru's race? Do not, therefore, at any time think of doing a wrong act.

sa: ततो वृक्षौषधितृणं समाहूय पितामहः। इममर्थं महाराज वक्तुं समुपचक्रमे॥
en: The Grandfather then summoned the tree, the herbs, and all sorts of grass to him, and begged them to take upon themselves a fourth of that sin.

sa: अनादिमध्यपर्यन्तं ज्ञानैश्चर्यमचिन्तितम्। आत्मानं परमं यस्माद् वरं तस्माद् वृणीमहे॥
en: I beg boons from Him who is without beginning and middle and end, who is Knowledge and Power, who is inconceivable and who is the Supreme Soul.

sa: तस्मादुन्मज्जनस्यार्थे प्रयतेत विचक्षणः। एतदुन्मज्जनं तस्य यदयं ब्राह्मणो भवेत्॥
en: For these reasons the wise and intelligent {}}en should try to float over the stream of Time. He indeed, succeeds in keeping himself afloat who knows Brahma.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एतानीदृशकान् धर्मांस्तुलाधारः प्रशंसति॥ उपपत्त्याभिसम्पन्नान् नित्यं सद्भिर्निषेवितान्॥
en: These are the duties, O Yudhishthira, which Tuladhara spoke highly of-duties which are consistent with reason, and which are always followed by the good and the wise.

sa: अकामया कृतस्तत्र यज्ञो होत्रनुशासनात्। शुक्रस्य पुनराजातिः पर्णादो नाम धर्मवित्॥ तस्मिन् वने समीपस्थो मृगोऽभूत् सहवासिकः। वचोभिरब्रवीत् सत्यं त्वयेदं दुष्कृतं कृतम्॥ यदि मन्त्रागहीनोऽयं यज्ञो भवति वै कृतः। मां भोः प्रक्षिप होत्रे त्वं गच्छ स्वर्गमनिन्दितः॥
en: Although reluctant she still celebrated that sacrifice at the command of her husband who had become its Hotri. In that forest, near to the Brahmana's hermitage, lived a neighbour of his, viz., the virtuous Parnada of Shukra's race, having assumed the form of a deer. He addressed that Brahmana, whose name was Satya. in open words and said to him:-You would be acting very improperly, if this sacrifice of yours were accomplished being defective in Mantras and other particulars of ritual! I, therefore, ask you to kill and cut me into pieces for making libations therewith on your sacrificial fire! Do this and becoming blameless go to heaven!

sa: अपराधं समाचक्ष्व पुरुषस्य स्वभावतः। शुक्रमन्यत्र सम्भूतं पुनरन्यत्र गच्छति॥
en: Do you ascribe it as one of the faults of man! The seminal fluid, originating in one's nature from sight of one person, goes to another person.

sa: ततस्त्रेतायुगे काले संस्पर्शाज्जायते प्रजा। न ह्यभून्मैथुनो धर्मस्तेषामपि जनाधिप॥
en: In the cycle that followed, viz., Treta, children were begotten by touch alone. The people of that cycle even, O king, had no necessity of sexual intercourse.

sa: क्षीणकोशो ह्यमावास्यां चन्द्रमा न प्रकाशते। तद्वन्मूर्तिविमुक्तोऽसौ शरीरी नोपलभ्यते॥
en: On the fifteenth day of the dark fortnight, the gross body of the moon is seen. Similarly the Soul, when freed from the body, cannot be apprehended.

sa: शूद्रोऽहमभवं पूर्वं तापसो भृशसंयुतः। ऋषिरुग्रतपास्त्वं च तदाभूद् द्विजसत्तम॥
en: In my former life I was a Shudra engaged in the practice of severe penances. You, O best of twiceborn persons, were a Rishi of austere penances.

sa: यदन्यैर्विहितं नेच्छेदात्मनः कर्म न तत् परेषु कुर्वीत जानन्नप्रिययात्मनः॥
en: A person should never do that to others which he does not like to be done to him by others, knowing how painful it is to himself.

sa: प्रकृतिर्गुणान् विकुरुते स्वच्छन्देनात्मकाम्यया। क्रीडार्थे तु महाराज शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Nature, cheerfully and of her own accord, as if for sport, O king produces, by undergoing changes herself, thousands and thousands of combinations of her original qualities.

sa: तत्र न्याय्यमिदं कर्तुं भारावतरणं मया। अथ नानासमुद्भूतैर्वसुधायां यथाक्रमम्॥
en: It is, therefore, proper that I should now and then lighten the burden of the Earth, by assuming various forms one after another as occasion would require.

sa: एवंस्वभावमेवैतत् तद् बुद्ध्वा विहरेन्नरः। अशोचन्नप्रहष्यंश्च स वै विगतमत्सरः॥
en: This is there nature. Knowing this, one should live cheerfully, without giving way to either grief or joy. Such a man is above the influence of pride.

sa: तेषां प्रतिष्ठिता कीर्तिर्यावत् स्थाम्यति मेदिनी। दानयज्ञप्रजासगैरेते हि दिवमाप्नुवन्॥
en: Their fame will last as long as the Earth lierself will exist. All of them have, by gifts and sacrifices and procreation of children proceeded to heaven.

sa: पराशर उवाच प्रसाद्येह पुरा शर्वं मनसाचिन्तयं नृप। महातपा महातेजा महायोगी महायशाः॥ वेदव्यास: श्रियावासो ब्राह्मणः करुणान्वितः। अप्यसावीप्सितः पुत्रो मम स्याद् वै महेश्वरात्॥
en: Parashara said Formerly I pleased Sarva, O king. I then cherished the desire of getting a son who would be endued with great ascetic merit, and superior energy, and addressed to high Yoga, that would acquire worldwide fame, arrange the Vedas and become the home of prosperity, that would be devoted to the Vedas and the Brahmans and be famous for mercy. Such a son was desired by me from Maheshvara.

sa: समासतस्तु यद् व्यासः पुरुषैकत्वमुक्तवान्। तत् तेऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रसादादमितौजसः॥
en: Through the favour of Vyasa of great energy, I shall explain to you what Vyasa has said in brief on this question of the Oneness of Soul.

sa: मनुरुवाच यदिन्द्रियैस्तूपहितं पुरस्तात् प्राप्तान् गुणान् सस्मरते चिराय। तेष्विन्द्रियेषूपहतेषु पश्चात् स बुद्धिरूप: परमः स्वभावः॥
en: Manu said The mind united with the senses, remembers after a long time the impressions of objects received in the past. When the action of the senses is suspended, the Supreme Soul in the form in the Understanding, exists in its own true nature.

sa: अनवज्ञा पितुर्युक्ता धारणं मातृरक्षणम्। युक्तक्षमावुभावेतौ नातिवर्तेत मां कथम्॥
en: Regard for the father's order is obligatory. The protection of my mother is equally a duty. How shall I so act that both obligations may be satisfied?

sa: एवं सुबहुशस्तस्य शूद्रस्य भरतर्षभ। सोऽगच्छदाश्रममृषिः शूद्रं द्रष्टुं नरर्षभ॥
en: In this way, O chief of the Bharatas, that Rishi, O best of men, came into the hermitage of the Shudra in numerable times for seeing him.

sa: मानुषत्वाद् दिवं याति दिवो मानुष्यमेव च। मानुष्यान्निरयस्थानमानन्त्यं प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: From the status of humanity he goes to heaven and from heaven he returns to humanity, and from humanity he sinks into hell for many long years.

sa: यथा भर्नाश्रयो धर्मः स्त्रीणां लोके युधिष्ठिर। स देवः सा गतिर्नान्या क्षत्रियस्य तथा द्विजाः॥
en: In this world, O Yudhishthira, the duties of women depend upon their husbands. To a woman, verily, the husband is the god and he is the highest end for which she should try. As the husband to wife, so are the Brahmanas to Kshatriyas.

sa: धर्मार्थकामकालेषु भार्या पुंसः सहायिनी। विदेशगमने चास्य सैव विश्वासकारिका॥
en: One's wife is his companion in all his acts of virtue, profit and desire. When one starts for a strange country his wife is his trusted companion.

sa: एतांश्चान्यांश्च रुचिरान् ब्रह्मणेऽमिततेजसे। अहं दत्त्वा वरान् प्रीतो निवृत्तिपरमोऽभवम्॥
en: Granting these and other highly agreeable boons to Brahman of great energy on account of my being propitiated with him I adopted the course dictated by Renunciation.

sa: इध्मार्थं तु गते तस्मिन्नग्निपुत्रे सुदर्शने। अतिथिळह्मणः श्रीमांस्तामाहौघवतीं तदा॥
en: Once on a time, when the son of Agni went out fetch fuel from the forest, a graceful Brahmana sought the hospitality of Oghavati with these words.

sa: न चैभिः पुण्यकर्माणो युज्यन्ते चाभिसंधिजैः। एवंविधैश्च बहुभिरपरैः प्राकृतैरपि॥
en: Those man who are righteous never meet with such or similar deaths even if they be afflicted with mental and physical diseases of the most painful sort.

sa: एतद् वः कथितं सर्वं यन्मां पृच्छत पुत्रकाः। पूर्वजन्म भविष्यं च भक्तानां स्नेहतो मया॥
en: You sons, actuated by my great love for yourselves who are devoted to me with reverence, I have told you everything about what you wished to know from me. viz., my first birth in days gone by and that other birth subsequent to it.

sa: अप्रमत्तेषु जाग्रत्सु नित्ययुक्तेषु शत्रुषु। अन्तरं लिप्समानेषु बालस्त्वं नावबुध्यसे॥
en: Your enemies are careful and awake and ever-ready (to assail you) and always watchful of their opportunity. Why are you so foolish as not to know this?

sa: एष भार्गवदायादो मुनिर्मान्यो दृढव्रतः। सुराणां विप्रियकरो निमित्ते कारणात्मके॥
en: O firm vows and respected by all, Ushanas, that descendant of Bhrigu's race, became engaged in doing what was disagreeable to the gods for some good cause.

sa: उपसंहरतस्तस्य तमग्नि रोषजं तदा। प्रादुर्बभूव विश्वेभ्यः खेभ्यो नारी महात्मनः॥ कृष्णरक्ताम्बरधरा कृष्णनेत्रतलान्तरा। दिव्यकुण्डलसम्पन्ना दिव्याभरणभूषिता॥
en: After the Self-create had withdrawn and suppressed that fire, there came out, from all the pores of his body, a lady dressed in robes of black and red, with black eyes, black palms, wearing a pair of charming ear-rings and bedecked with celestial ornaments.

sa: पुत्रपौत्रोपपन्नोऽपि जननीं यः समाश्रितः। अपि वर्षशतस्यान्ते स द्विहायनवच्चरेत्॥
en: A person whose mother exists, even if he has sons and grandsons and even if he is a hundred years old, looks like a child of two.

sa: राजोवाच यदि विप्र विसृष्टं ते जप्यस्य फलमुत्तमम्। आवयोर्यत् फलं किञ्चित् सहितं नौ तदस्त्विह॥
en: The king said If, O Brahmana, you are really prepared to give me the excellent reward of your recitation, then let half that reward be mine, you also take at the same time half the reward that I myself have gained by my acts.

sa: संकल्पजो मित्रवर्गो ज्ञातयः कारणात्मकाः। भार्या पुत्रश्च दासश्च स्वमर्थमनुयुज्यते॥
en: One's friends who originate from his determination, and one's kinsmen whose attachment is due to selfish reasons, one's wives and sons and servants only devour his riches.

sa: जघन्यशायी पूर्वं स्यादुत्थाय गुरुवेश्मनि। यच्च शिष्येण कर्तव्यं कार्यं दासेन वा पुनः॥ कृतमित्येव तत्सर्वं कृत्वा तिष्ठेत पार्श्वतः। किंकरः सर्वकारी स्यात् सर्वकर्मसु कोविदः॥
en: While living in the preceptor's house, he should seek bed after the preceptor has gone to his and rise therefrom before the preceptor rises from his. He should do all such acts again which a disciple as also a menial servant should do. Doing these he should humbly stand by his preceptor. Skilled in every kind of work, he should act like a menial servant, doing every act for his preceptor.

sa: विन्ध्यस्य तु गिरेः पाते सम्प्रपुष्पितपादपे। उपविश्य महात्मानश्चिन्तामापेदिरे तदा॥
en: Then sitting down at the foot of the Vindhya mountain, containing blossoming trees, at that time* those high-souled ones indulged-in reflections. *i.e. at the beginning of winter.

sa: किं पुनर्यो गुणश्लाघ्यः सानुक्रोशो जितेन्द्रियः। स्थिरानुरागो धर्मात्मा मातृवत्पितृवत्प्रियः॥
en: And to be said of one that is crowned with qualities, kind, self-controlled, of steady affection, righteous-souled, and who is dear as a father or a mother?

sa: वने त्वदृष्टदुःखानां कैकेय्यनुमते त्वया। त्यक्तानां वनवासाय कान्यावस्था भविष्यति।७।।
en: Despatched by you to the woods at the command of Kaikeyi, to what a plight will they, not inured to the privations of a forest-life, be reduced!

sa: तदिदं मित्रकार्यं नः कालातीतमरिंदम। क्रियतां राघवस्यैतद् वैदेह्याः परिमार्गणम्॥
en: O slayer of foes, soon shall the time for performing your friend's service, be over; do you therefore encompass Rāghava's good, namely the searching out of Vaidehī.

sa: अदृष्टदुःखं राजानं वृद्धमार्यं जितेन्द्रियम्। ब्रूयास्त्वमभिवाद्यैव मम हेतोरिदं वचः॥
en: Do you saluting him for me say these words to the aged monarch who has his senses under complete control, and who has never seen misfortune before.

sa: तेषामञ्जलिपद्मानि प्रगृहीतानि सर्वशः। प्रतिगृह्याब्रवीद् राजा तेभ्यः प्रियहितं वचः॥
en: And when they had raised to their heads their clasped hands resembling lotuses, the king responding to them addressed them in welcome words fraught with their good.

sa: तत्कार्मुकैराभरणै रथैश्च तद्वर्मभिश्चाग्निसमानवर्णैः। बभूव सैन्यं पिशिताशनानां सूर्योदये नीलमिवाभ्रजालम्।
en: Furnished with bows and ornaments and cars and mail hued like fire, that army of those subsisting on flesh, appeared like masses of blue clouds at sunrise.

sa: तां धर्षणामदूरस्थां संदृश्यात्मनि पार्थिवः। चिन्तार्णवगतः पारं नाससादाप्लवो यथा॥
en: Perceiving this obloquy at a short distance, the king was plunged in a sea of anxiety, but could not cross it, like one that has no raft.

sa: स चाप्यपुत्रो नृपतिस्तस्मिन् काले महाद्युतिः। अयजद् पुत्रियामिष्टिं पुत्रेप्सुररिसूदनः॥
en: At that time, eagerly wishing to have sons, that destroyer of enemies, the effulgent king Dasaratha, who was sonless, was celebrating the sacrifice that confer male offspring.

sa: सहस्राक्षस्य तत्सर्वं विज्ञाय मुनिपुङ्गवः। रम्भां क्रोधसमाविष्टः शशाप कुशिकात्मजः॥
en: And knowing for certain that it was the thousand-eyed deity who had devised all that, that foremost of anchorets, Kusika's son, overwhelmed with anger, cursed Rambha, saying,

sa: द्रक्ष्यन्ति नूनं पुरुषा दीर्घबाहुं वनेचराः। राममुत्थाय गच्छन्तं लोकनाथमनाथवत्॥
en: The rangers of the woods will now see the long-armed Rāma resembling the lord himself of the worlds, rising from the ground and going like one forlorn.

sa: स्वपुरं त्वगमच्छीमानिष्टयज्ञो महीपतिः। गङ्गायाश्चागमे राजा निश्चयं नाध्यगच्छत ॥
en: And having seen the completion of the sacrifice, that lord of earth entered his capital; but the king could not see how to bring Gangā on earth.

sa: अद्य ते कतिचिद् रात्र्यश्च्युतस्यार्यकवेश्मनः। अपि नाध्वश्रमः शीघ्रं रथेनापततस्तव॥
en: How many days hence did you leave the residence of the revered one? Have you felt any fatigue on the way incident to the car proceeding swiftly?

sa: नन्वसौ काञ्चनैर्बाणैर्महावीर्यो महाभुजः। युगान्त इव भूतानि सागरानपि निर्दहेत्॥
en: Surely, that mighty-armed one endowed with exceeding prowess, can with his golden shafts burn all creatures and the oceans, like the Day at the dissolution of all.

sa: स प्रविश्याश्रमपदं शिष्येण सह धर्मवित्। उपविष्टः कथाश्चान्याश्चकार ध्यानमास्थितः॥
en: Having entered the hermitage along with his disciple, conversant with righteousness engaged in diverse kinds of talk, revolved in his mind the circumstances connected with the verses.

sa: अथोपविश्य भगवानासने परमार्चिते। वाल्मीकये च ऋषये संदिदेशासनं ततः॥
en: Having sat-down on a highly-honoured seat, that worshipful one enquired after the welfare of that sage Vālmīki knowing no deterioration, and then asked him to be seated.

sa: सूत इत्येव चाभाष्य सारथिं तमभीक्ष्णशः। हंसमत्तस्वरः श्रीमानुवाच पुरुषोत्तमः॥
en: Then frequently addressing the charioteer, saying, "O Suta", that best of men furnished with grace and endowed with a voice like that of a mad swan, spoke.

sa: बभूव हृष्टा नचिरेण चानती प्रियस्य रामस्य समागमं तदा॥
en: Desired by Bharata to halt, that army, looking in the direction of the smoke, rejoiced soon on learning that the beloved Rāma had arrived (at that place).

sa: स च्छिन्नपक्षः सहसा रक्षसा रौद्रकर्मणा। निपपात महागृध्रो धरण्यामल्पजीवितः॥
en: The ranger of the night of cruel deeds having şundered his wings, the king of vultures approaching well-nigh the verge of death, fell। down on the earth.

sa: सर्वलोकप्रियं त्यक्त्वा सर्वलोकहिते रते। सर्वलोकोऽनुरज्येत कथं चानेन कर्मणा॥
en: Renouncing one that is universally dear, and that is ever engaged in the good of all, how by such an act will the king please the people?

sa: यदि ाकाले मरणं यदृच्छया लभेत कश्चिद् गुरुदुःखकर्शितः। गताहमचैव परेतसंसदं विना त्वया धेनुरिवात्मजेन वै॥
en: If any body in this life, being pressed down with some great calamity, could meet with death of his own accord, I would have instantly gone to the abode of death, being cut off from you like to a cow from her young one.

sa: निदेशवर्तिनः सर्वे सर्वे गुरुहिते स्थिताः। अभिप्रेतमनुष्ठातुं तव शक्ष्यन्त्यरिंदम॥
en: All abide by your command all are intent upon the welfare of their master, and, O subduer of foes, they are competent to bring about your end.

sa: नाराजके जनपदे चरत्येकचरो वशी। भावयन्नात्मनात्मानं यत्रसायं गृहो मुनिः॥
en: In a kingless country the ascetic with his subdued senses, himself his sole protector, who makes his quarters wherever evening overtakes him, cannot walk contemplating the Deity.

sa: सा पानयोगाच्च निवृत्तलज्जा दृष्टिप्रसादाच्च सरेन्द्रसूनोः। वाक्यं महार्थं परिसान्त्वरूपम्॥
en: Renouncing modesty under the influence of liquor, and finding the king's son well pleased, Tārā spoke to Lakşmaņa, bold and loving words, in order to console him.

sa: किमयं कामवृत्तस्ते लुप्तधर्मार्थसंग्रहः। भर्ता भर्तहिते युक्ते न चैनमवबुध्यसे॥
en: O you intent on your husband's welfare, did you not perceive that your husband is by and by losing piety and wealth, being addicted to amorcus enjoyments.?

sa: ये हि सम्भिन्नमर्यादा नास्तिकाश्छिन्नसंशयाः। तेऽपि भावाय कल्पन्ते राजदण्डनिपीडिताः॥
en: Even those heretics who having disregarded the dignity of social morality had met with chastisement at the hands of the king, their fear removed, give themselves airs.

sa: मृगयूथनिपीतानि कलुषाम्भांसि साम्प्रतम्। तीर्थानि रमणीयानि रतिं संजनयन्ति मे॥
en: And the waters rendered muddy in consequence of herds of deer drinking of them, as well as the graceful descents to the river, fill me with pleasure.

sa: पापस्वभावश्चपल: कथं त्वं रक्षसां वर। ऐश्वर्यमभिसम्प्राप्तो विमानमिव दुष्कृती॥
en: O you the best of Rākṣasas, you are vicious and unsteady; how have you come by riches like to a sinner attaining to the abode of celestials?

sa: विष्ठिताश्च यथान्यायं राघवौ च यथार्हतः। सम्प्रहृष्टमना रामो विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: And the descendants of Raghu also sat down, occupying prominent places as befitted their rank. Then Rāma with a heart surcharged with cheerfulness spoke to Viśvāmitra, saying,

sa: ततः पर्वतशृङ्गाभस्तीक्ष्णतुण्डः खगोत्तमः। वनस्पतिगतः श्रीमान् व्याजहार शुभां गिरम्॥
en: There-at the lord of birds resting on the tree, having a big sharp beak like to the summit of a hill, addressed these soft words to Rāvana,

sa: स जगाम वनं वीरः प्रतिज्ञामनुपालयन्। पितुर्वचननिर्देशात् कैकेय्याः प्रियकारणात्॥
en: In pursuance of his father's promise, and with the view of compassing the pleasure of Kaikeyī, that heroic one, commanded by his sire, repaired to the forest.

sa: युष्माकं राघवोऽरण्ये योगक्षेमं विधास्यति। सीता नारीजनस्यास्य योगक्षेमं करिष्यति॥
en: In the forest Rāghava will attain for you the unattainable and protect what is attained; and Sītā being a female will do the same for these (women.)

sa: अन्तःपुरस्य द्वाराणि सर्वस्य नगरस्य च। चन्दनस्रग्भिरच॑न्तां धूपैश्च घ्राणहारिभिः॥
en: And do you embellish all the door-ways of the inner apartment as well as those of the entire city with garlands with sandal paste and fragrant Dhūpa.

sa: कालो नि:संशयो नूनं जीवितान्तकरस्तव। बलाद् येनावपन्नोऽसि सुग्रीवस्यावशो वशम्॥
en: Forsooth, you had been by force brought under the control of Kāla, since you had been discomfited by Sugrīva, albeit you are above the control of others.

sa: अध्वना वातवेगेन सम्भ्रमेणातपेन च। न विगच्छति वैदेह्याश्चन्द्रांशुसदृशी प्रभा॥
en: Neither through the fatigue of travel, nor the influence of the wind, nor excitement, nor the sun, has Vaidehi's lustre resembling the lunar light suffered any diminution.

sa: वहुसैन्यं महावीर्यं जनस्थाने निवेशितम्। सदूषणखरं युद्धे निहतं रामसायकैः॥
en: A great many troops endued with exceeding prowess, who had been posted in Janasthāna, have, along with Düşana and Khara, been slain by the shafts of Rāma.

sa: ततः पश्चात् सुखं रामे भार्याहरणकर्शिते। विस्रब्धं प्रहरिष्यामि कृतार्थेनान्तरात्मना॥
en: Then when Rāma shall be sore afflicted because of the carrying off of his wife, I shall easily, crowning my soul with success, safely bear away Sita.

sa: ततो यज्ञे समाप्ते तु ऋतूनां षट् समत्ययुः। ततश्च द्वादशे मासे चैत्रे नावमिके तिथौ॥ नक्षत्रेऽदितिदैवत्ये स्वोच्चसंस्थेषु पञ्चसु। ग्रहेषु कर्कटे लग्ने वाक्पताविन्दुना सह॥ प्रोद्यमाने जगन्नाथं सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम्। कौसल्याजनयद् रामं दिव्यलक्षणसंयुतम्॥ विष्णोरर्धं महाभागं पुत्रमैक्ष्वाकुनन्दनम्। लोहिताक्षं महाबाहुं रक्तोष्ठं दुन्दुभिस्वनम् ॥ कौसल्या शुशुभे तेन पुत्रेणामिततेजसा। यथा वरेण देवानामदितिर्वज्रपाणिना॥
en: And then when the six seasons had rolled away after the completion of the sacrifice, in the twelfth month, on the ninth lunar day, under the influence of the Punarvasu asterism presided by Aditi devatā, when the Sun, the Moon, Saturn, Jupiter, and Venus were at Arius, Capricorn, Libra, Cancer, And Pisces, and when Jupiter had arisen with the Moon at Cancer, Kausalyā gave birth to that lord of the universe, bowed to by all the worlds, Rāma, the descendant of Iksvaku, furnished with excellent marks, the one half of Vişnu,-exceedingly righteous, with rosy eyes, and mighty arms, and crimson nether lip, and endowed with a voice like the sound of a kettledrum. Then on having given birth to that son of immeasurable prowess, Kausalyā looked resplendent, like Aditi on having brought forth that fore

sa: अद्य ते कालपाशे नीता वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥ सप्तजातिशतान्येव मृतपाः सम्भवन्तु ते। श्वमांसनियताहारा मुष्टिका नाम निघृणाः॥ वचनं विकृताश्च विरूपाश्च लोकाननुचरन्त्विमान्। महोदयश्च दुर्बुद्धिर्मामदूष्यं ह्यदूषयत्॥ दूषितः सर्वलोकेषु निषादत्वं गमिष्यति।
en: And this very day bound by the noose of Kala, meeting with destruction at the hands of Vivaśvata's son, (Yama) they shall for seven hundred firths range these worlds, wearing dead men's clothes, always feeding on dogs' flesh, going by the name of Mahodaya also has blamed me, although undeserving of blame; therefore, reproved of all, he shall undergo Nişadahood. And becoming cruel, and engaged in taking life, he shall through my ire fare wretchedly for a long lapse of time.'

sa: स प्रविश्य तु तद्वेश्म रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। अपश्यद् राक्षसीमध्ये सीतां दुःखपरायणाम्॥ अश्रुपूर्णमुखीं दीनां शोकभारावपीडिताम्। वायुवेगैरिवाक्रान्तां मज्जन्ती नावमर्णवे॥
en: And entering that apartment, Rāvana-lord of Rākşasas-saw the distressed Sītā in the midst of the Raksasas, with a tearful countenance, oppressed with a load of grief, like to a bark sinking in the ocean through the violence of the winds; like to a doe separated from the herd of deer, and surrounded by dogs.

sa: नाश्रौषमिति राजानमुपालब्धोऽपि वक्ष्यसि । चिरं दुःखस्य पापिष्ठमिति रामस्तमब्रवीत्॥
en: Rāma said to him, “When taxed by the monarch (on your return), you will say, 'I did not hear you.' But delay will impart me terrible pain."

sa: तमप्रतिमतेजोभ्यां भ्रातृभ्यां रोमहर्षणम्। विस्मिताः संगमं प्रेक्ष्य समुपेता महर्षयः॥
en: Observing the meeting of the two brothers of unparalleled energy, capable of making one's hair stand on end, the Maharsis struck with surprise came to the scene.

sa: वनेऽस्मिन् मामके नित्यं पुत्रवत् परिरक्षिते। पत्राङ्कुरविनाशाय फलमूलाभवाय च॥
en: This my forest is being protected by me every day like to my own son—and the monkeys are always used to destroy its leaves, trees and roots.

sa: प्रीतस्तेऽहं नरश्रेष्ठ करिष्यामि तव प्रियम्। शिरसा धारयिष्यामि शैलराजसुतामहम्॥
en: O foremost of men, I am well pleased with you: I will do what will before your welfare. I will hold the Mountain's daughter on my head.

sa: एतच्छौटीर्ययुक्तं ते मच्छन्दवशवर्तिनः। इदानीमसि मारीचः पूर्वमन्यो हि राक्षसः॥
en: This is worthy of your heroism that you have addressed yourself to act after my desire. You were another Raksasa before and have now become true Mārīca.

sa: कृतं चेन्नातिजानीषे राघवस्य महात्मनः सद्यस्त्वं निशितैर्भाणैर्हतो द्रक्ष्यसि वालिनम्॥
en: You did not acknowledge the good offices rendered to you by the high-souled Rāghava; and therefore, slain by means of sharpened shafts, you shall soon see Vali.

sa: स तु स्वबलवीर्येण समुत्क्षिप्य निशाचरः। बालाविव स्कन्धगतौ चकारातिर्बलोद्धतः॥
en: And lifting up (Rāma and Lakşmana) by his might and. prowess, as if they were striplings, that haughty ranger of the night laid them on his shoulders.

sa: एवमुक्ता तु रामेण बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा॥ कौसल्या पुत्रशोकार्ता रामं वचनमब्रवीत्।
en: Being thus accosted by Rāma, Kausalyā being distressed with the thought of separation from her son, spoke to him with tears in her eyes the following words.

sa: उपरुध्यन्ति मे प्राणा दृष्टिभ्रमति राघव। पश्यामि वृक्षान् सौवर्णानुशीरकृतमूर्धजान्॥
en: O Rāghava, my life is about to expire, my eye-sight has grown of mistaken perception, I see trees before me made of gold having hair resembling Usira.

sa: प्लवगप्रवरैर्दृष्टः प्लवने कृतनिश्चयः। ववृधे रामवृद्ध्यर्थं समुद्र इव पर्वसु॥
en: The foremost of the Vānaras at this stared at him, he swelled in size for the purpose of Rāma as the ocean swells on the full-moon days.

sa: ततो नान्दीमुखीं रात्रि भरतं सूतमागधाः। तुष्टुवुः सविशेषज्ञाः स्तवैर्मङ्गलसंस्तवैः॥
en: Then seeing that the night in which had been performed the auspicious preliminary ceremonies, was about to be spent, eulogists and genealogists hymned Bharata with consecrated hymns.

sa: धर्मविद् धर्मशीलश्च महाभागो दृढव्रतः। आर्ये किमब्रवीद् राजा पिता मे सत्यविक्रमः॥ पश्चिमं साधुसंदेशमिच्छामि श्रोतुमात्मनः।
en: And, O noble lady, what did that virtuous one cognizant of virtue, that pre-eminently pious one, firm in his vow, and having truth for prowess, even my father, say? I wish to hear news concerning us relative to the last moments of the monarch.

sa: अद्यायमपि ते पुत्रः क्लेशानामतथोचितः। नीचानर्थसमाचारं सज्जं कर्म प्रमुञ्चतु॥
en: To day let your son, who does not deserve such toilsome work, cease to perform that office which is fraught with hardship fit only for the base.

sa: समाश्वासय दीनं त्वमङ्गदं दीनचेतसम्। मा भूर्बालिशबुद्धिस्त्वं त्वदधीनमिदं पुरम्॥
en: Do you console the unfortunate Angada, who is beside himself with grief. Do not conduct yourself like an ignorant person, for this city is now under you.

sa: देव्यनूढा त्वमभवो युवराजो भवाम्यहम्। ततः प्रावृडनुप्राप्ता मम कामविवर्धिनी॥
en: O lady, you were then unwedded; and I was a youthful prince. And it was at this time that the rainy season increasing my desire set in.

sa: इयं सराष्ट्रा सजना धनधान्यसमाकुला। मया विसृष्टा वसुधा भरताय प्रदीयताम्॥ वनवासकृता बुद्धिर्न च मेऽद्य चलिष्यति। यस्तु युद्धे वरो दत्तः कैकेय्यै वरद त्वया।॥ दीयतां निखिलेनैव सत्यस्त्वं भव पार्थिव।
en: Do you bestow upon Bharata this earth renounced by me, this kingdom abounding in corn and kine and filled with people; my mind determined upon dwelling in the forest, does not waver. Do you, O bestower of boons, grant Kaikeyi everything that you had promised to her at the time of the war* Another reading is, The boon that you had well-pleased conferred., Another reading, Nor Mithila's daughter., Another reading is, Nor any of these worlds., (you had waged against the Dänavas), and thereby do you follow truth.

sa: माता पिता बान्धवानां वरिष्ठौ भार्या जरा बीजमात्रं तु पुत्रः। भ्राता शत्रुः क्लित्रपाणिर्वयस्य आत्मा ह्येकः सुखदुःखस्य भोक्ता॥
en: The parents only are the best of friends. The wife is merely a soil for sowing seeds. The son is only one's seed. The brother is an enemy. The friend or companion wants to have his palms oiled if he is to continue so. One's own self enjoys or suffers one's happiness or misery.

sa: द्विषतो भीमसेनस्य क्रुद्धस्य वशमेष्यथ। पितामहैराचरितं न धर्मं हातुमर्हथ॥
en: Will you place yourselves under the power of our enemy Bhima? It is not proper that you should neglect the duties followed by your fathers and grand-fathers.

sa: भक्ष्याभक्ष्येषु चान्येषु वाच्यावाच्ये तथैव च। अज्ञानज्ञानयो राजन् विहितान्यनुजानतः॥
en: As regards sins regarding unclean food and the like, and improper speeches, etc., they are of two classes, viz., those committed knowingly and those that committed unconsciously.

sa: कुशलाकुशलान्येके कृत्वा कर्माणि मानवाः। कार्यकारणसंश्लिष्टं स्वजनं नाम बिभ्रति॥
en: Doing both auspicious and inauspicious acts here, a class of men maintain their wives, children, and kinsmen, all bound to them in relations of cause and effect.

sa: श्रमाभिभूताः सरंब्धाः श्रान्तवाहाः पिपासवः। विक्षताश्च शितैः शस्त्रैरभ्यवर्तन्त तावकाः॥
en: At that time, your soldiers, exhausted and worked up with rage, their animals fatigued, themselves thirsty, wounded with sharp weapons, began to turn away from the battle.

sa: असकृद्वदतस्तस्य दुर्योधनवधेन च॥ दुःखशोकाभिसंतप्तो न श्रोष्ये परुषा गिरः।
en: He will frequently speak of the slaughter of Duryodhana in my ears. Burning with grief and sorrow, I shall not be able to withstand his cruel words!"

sa: मानुषीणां मृगीणां च न पिबेद् ब्राह्मणः पयः॥ प्रेतान्नं सूतिकानं च यच्च किंचिदनिर्दशम्। अभोज्यं चाप्यपेयं च धेनोर्दुग्धमनिर्दशम्॥
en: Besides this the good that has been offered to the departed manes, that which has been usurer cooked by a woman who has recently given birth to a child, and food cooked by a unknown person, should not be taken. The milk also of a cow that has recently calved should not be drunk.

sa: शत्रुभिर्बहुभिर्गस्तो यथा वर्तेत पार्थिवः। एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं सर्वमेव यथाविधि।॥
en: I wish to hear everything in connection with the duties of king when he is attacked by many foes, as has been laid down in the scriptures.

sa: परस्परस्य सुहृदौ विहितौ समचेतसौ। ब्रह्मक्षत्रस्य सम्मानात् प्रजा सुखमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: It is laid down that they should have similar hearts and should be each other's friends. For such friendship between Brahmana and Kshatriya, the subjects become happy.

sa: अनागतविधाता च प्रत्युत्पन्नमतिश्च यः। द्वावेव सुखमेधेते दीर्घसूत्रो विनश्यति॥
en: Therefore these two only, viz., he, who has much forethought and he, who has presence of mind, can secure happiness. An idle person, however, meets with destruction.

sa: पाण्डुरेण च माल्येन पताकाभिश्च मेदिनी। संस्कृतो राजमार्गोऽभूद्धूपनैश्च प्रधूपितः॥
en: The part through which the king passed had been adorned with white festoons of flowers and numberless flags. The streets of the city were perfumed with incense.

sa: ध्वजिन्यां हतनेत्रायां यथेष्टं श्वेतवाहनः। चरिष्यति महाबाहुः कक्षेष्वग्निरिव ज्वलन्॥
en: The mighty-armed Arjuna of white horses will, at his pleasure, move about amidst your army having no commander, like a blazing fire amid a heap of grass.

sa: येषामर्थाय पापं स्याद् विजयस्य सुहृद्वधैः। निर्जितैरप्रमत्तैर्हि विजिता जितकाशिनः॥
en: They for whose sake we gained the sinful victory by killing our kinsmen and friends, after acquired victory, have been defeated by vanquished foes that were hecdful.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रो ददौ राजा पुत्राणामौर्ध्वदेहिकम्। सर्वकामगुणोपेतमन्नं गाश्च धनानि च॥
en: King Dhritarashtra also distributed, for the good of his dead sons, excellent food, and kine, and immense wealth, and many beautiful and costly gems amongst the Brahmanas.

sa: यथा दुर्योधनगृहं तथा दुःशासनस्य तु। प्रासादमाला संयुक्तं हेमतोरणभूषितम्॥ दासीदाससुसम्पूर्ण प्रभूतधनधान्यवत्। प्रतिपेदे महाबाहुरर्जुनो राजशासनात्॥
en: The Mighty-armed Arjuna also, at the king's behest obtained the palace of Dushasana which was not inferior to Duryodhana's and which considered of many excellent mansions and was adorned with a golden gate-way, and which was full of riches and attendant of both sexes.

sa: अथ शीतपरीताङ्गो जम्बुकः क्षुच्छ्रमान्वितः। सदारस्तां गुहामाशु प्रविवेश जलार्दितः॥
en: Wetted by the rain and shivering with cold, a jackal, with his wife, dragged himself with difficulty towards that very cave and entered it quickly for protection,

sa: ताम्राक्ष्यस्ताम्रवर्णाश्च हर्यक्ष्यश्च तथा पराः॥ वरदाः कामचारिण्यो नित्यं प्रमुदितास्तथा।
en: Some had coppery eyes and coppery appearance and the eyes of some were green. Capable of granting boons and of walking at will, they were always cheerful.

sa: तस्मात् संजनयेत् कोशं सत्कृत्य परिपालयेत्। परिपाल्यानुतनुयादेष धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: For these reasons the treasury must be replenished; and when filled, it should be carefully kept, and even sought to be increased. This is the eternal practice.

sa: येषां बलकृता वृत्तिस्तेषामन्या न रोचते। तेजभासिप्रवर्तन्ते बलवन्तो युधिष्ठिर।॥
en: They, who always support themselves by displaying their power, never prefer any other mode of living. The powerful, O Yudhishthira, always live by the help of prowess.

sa: लवयन्तः प्लवन्तश्च वल्लान्तश्च महारथाः। धावन्तो जवना मुण्डाः पवनोद्धृतमूर्धजाः॥
en: Quick in their motions, they ran about most dreadfully, the hair on their heads waving in the air, like infuriate elephants and frequently sending up loud roars.

sa: ज्ञानवृद्धाः प्रशंसन्ति शुश्रूषन्तः परस्परम्। विनिवृत्ताभि संधानाः संखमेधन्ति सर्वशः॥
en: Wise people speak highly of those nobles who are united with one another in ties of love. If of one purpose, all of them can be happy.

sa: माहात्म्येन च संयुक्ताः कामरूपधरास्तथा॥ निर्मांसगात्र्यः श्वेताश्च तथा काञ्चनसंनिभाः।
en: Of ascetic merit, they were capable of assuming forms at will. Not having fleshy limbs, they were of fair complexions and endued with the lustre of gold.

sa: रथप्रवरमास्थाय सैन्धवाश्वं महारथः॥ तस्य सूतो महाराज रथस्थोऽशोभयद् रथम्।
en: And that mighty car-warrior drove an excellent car having horses of the Sindhu breed yoked to it. Riding upon his car, his driver made the car resplendent.

sa: अभिषेकं कुमारस्य दृष्ट्वा हृष्टा रणप्रियाः॥ घण्टाजालपिनद्धाङ्गा ननृतुस्ते महौजसः।
en: Beholding the investiture of Kartikeya, those mighty and energetic followers, taking delight in battle and wearing on their persons rows of tinkling bells, danced round him joyfully.

sa: युगान्ते सूर्याहत्य महोल्केव दिवश्च्युता। अथ हेमत्सरं दिव्यं खड्गमाकाशवर्चसम्॥
en: Without losing a moment Ashvatthaman drew from its sheath an excellent sky-coloured scimitar having a golden hilt. The scimitar came out like a snake from its whole.

sa: भूरिश्रवा महेष्वासस्तथा प्रायगतो रणे। क्रोशतां भूमिपालानां युयुधानेन पातितः॥
en: So also, the great bowman Bhurishravas, while observing the Praya vow on the field of battle, was killed by Yuyudhana, disregarding the voice of all the kings.

sa: पझ्यामापततस्तस्य शरवृष्टिं समासृजत्॥ नुकलोऽप्यग्रसत् ता वै चर्मणा लघुविक्रमः।
en: As, however, he rushed on foot, his antagonist discharged a shower of arrows upon him. The highly active Nakula received that downpour of arrows on his shield.

sa: सर्वविद्यान्तगं श्रेष्ठं धनुर्वेदस्य पारगम्। रामं क्षत्रियहन्तारं प्रदीप्तमिव पावकम्॥
en: The foremost of men, that son mastered all the sciences, including that of arms. Like a burning fire, that son was Rama, the exterminator of the Kshatriyas.

sa: तथावृत्तौ कथां तात तावच्युतयुधिष्ठिरौ। जग्मतुर्यत्र गाङ्गेयः शरतल्पगतः प्रभुः॥
en: After this discourse, those two illustrious heroes, viz., Krishna of undecaying glory and Yudhishthira proceeded where the powerful son of Ganga lay on his bed of arrows.

sa: पुण्याहघोषैर्विमलैवैदानां निनदैस्तथा। देवेषु चैव व्यग्रेषु तस्मिन् यज्ञविधौ तदा॥
en: The spot was filled with the sound of the recitation and the chaunting of the Vedas. Seeing those sacrificial rites, even the very gods lost their temper.

sa: लोकनाथ महाबाहो शिव नारायणाच्युत। तव वाक्यमुपश्रुत्य हर्षेणास्मि परिप्लुतः॥
en: O lord of all the worlds, O mighty-armed one, O Shiva, O Narayana, O you of undecaying glory, hearing your words I have been filled with joy.

sa: तस्य तेन शिरः कायाजहार नृपसत्तम। पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: With that arrow, O best of kings, the son of Pandu cut off from Sushena's trunk his head before all the troops. That feat was highly wonderful.

sa: पठन्ति पाणिस्वनिकास्तथा गायन्ति गायनाः। शङ्खानथ मृदङ्गांश्च प्रवाद्यन्ति सहस्रशः॥
en: Others, keeping time by the clapping of hands, began to sing sweet hymns, and vocalists began to sing. Thousands of conchshells and drums were blown and beat.

sa: सूच्यग्रं नात्यजः पूर्वं स कथं त्यजसि क्षितिम्। एवमैश्वर्यमासाद्य प्रशास्य पृथिवीमिमाम्॥ को हि मूढो व्यवस्येत शत्रोर्दातुं वसुन्धराम्।
en: How is it that you, who could not formerly give up even that much of land which the point of a needle would cover, now wish to make over the entire Earth. What fool would, after having got such prosperity and governed the entire Earth, think of giving over that Earth to his focs.

sa: निर्मर्यादे महायुद्धे वर्तमाने सुदारुणे। प्रादुरासन् विनाशाय तदोत्पाताः सुदारुणाः॥
en: During the progress of that fierce encounter in which the warriors fought without any consideration for friends and foes, evil omens appeared, presaging the destruction of everything.

sa: दशैव तु सदाऽऽचार्यः श्रोत्रियानतिरिच्यते॥ दशाचार्यानुपाध्याय उपाध्यायान् पिता दश।
en: One Acharya is superior to ten Brahmanas learned in the Vedas. One Upadhyaya is again superior to ten Acharyas. The father, again, is superior to ten Upadhyayas.

sa: प्रत्यक्षेणानुमानेन तथौपम्यागमैरपि। परीक्ष्यास्ते महाराज स्वे परे चैव नित्यशः॥
en: By the direct evidence of the senses, by conjecture, by comparisons, and by the injunctions of the scriptures, O monarch, the king should study friends and enemies.

sa: स्वयं प्रहर्ता दाता च वश्यात्मा रम्यसाधनः। काले दाता च भोक्ता च शुद्धाचारस्तथैव च॥
en: The king should himself be clever in smitting. He should be liberal. He should have his mind under control. He should dress himself gorgeously. He should make presents in proper time and be regular in his meals. He should also be of good conduct.

sa: व्यवसायं समाधाय सूर्यो रश्मीनिवायतान्। धर्ममेवाभिरक्षेत कृत्वा तुल्ये प्रियाप्रिये॥
en: While settling the claims of litigants, the king, without making any difference between persons who are liked and those who are disliked by him, should preserve justice.

sa: दोषान् विवृणुयाच्छत्रोः परपक्षान् विधूनयेत्। काननेष्विव पुष्पाणि बहिरर्थान् समाचरन्॥
en: He should announce the faults of his enemies; crush those who are their partisans; and collect riches from outside like a person plucking flowers from the forest.

sa: दृष्ट्वा धर्मराजानं कौरवेयैस्तथा कृतम्। नामृष्यन्त सुसंरब्धाः शिखण्डिप्रमुखा रथाः॥
en: Then Pandava heroes, led by Shikhandin, beholding king Yudhishthira assailed in that way by the Kauravas, were filled with rage and unable to put up with it.

sa: कथमेको महीं कृत्स्ना शूरवीरार्यसंकुलाम्। रक्षत्यपि च लोकस्य प्रसादमभिवाञ्छति॥
en: Whence is it that one man governs the vast universe consisting of brave, energetic, wellborn and well-behaved men? Why do all men try to get his favour?

sa: स्त्रजो गन्धानलंकारान् वासांसि विविधानि च। किमर्थमभिसंत्यज्य परिव्रजसि निष्क्रियः॥
en: Why, indeed, do you lead a life of roving mendicancy, abstaining from all actions, after having forsaken garlands and perfumes and ornaments and robes of various sorts.

sa: नैतेनातिथयो राजन् देवर्षिपितरस्तथा। अद्य शक्यास्त्वया भर्तुं मोघस्तेऽयं परिश्रमः॥
en: With this handful of barley, O king, you will not be able to gratify your guests, gods, Rishis, and Pitris? This your labour, therefore, is in vain.

sa: कवची बद्धनिस्त्रिंशः सशरः सशरासनः। वेदवेदाङ्गविच्चैव धनुर्वेदे च पारगः॥
en: Clad in mail, armed with swords, bows and arrows, and well-versed in the science of war, he was also a master of the Vedas and their auxiliaries.

sa: वर्धमानमृणं तिष्ठेत् परिभूताश्च शत्रवः। जनयन्ति भयं तीव्र व्याधयश्चाप्युपेक्षिताः॥
en: Debt which always multiplies is sure to remain unless it is wholly paid up. Likewise are the defeated foes and neglected diseases. These always create great fear.

sa: तद्रजः पुरुषव्याघ्र शोणितेन प्रशामितम्॥ दिशश्च विमला जातास्तस्मिंस्तमसि नाशिते।
en: That dust, however, O foremost of men, was soon dispelled by the blood that was shed and all the points of the horizon became once more clear.

sa: ततो हिमवता दत्ते मणिप्रवरशोभिते। दिव्यारत्नाचिते पुण्ये निषण्णं परमासने॥
en: Himavat gave a seat which was set with many costly gems. Kartikeya was made a site on that sacred and best of seats set with excellent gems.

sa: तत्र तीरे सरस्वत्याः पुण्ये सर्वगुणान्विते। निषेदुर्देवगन्धर्वाः सर्वे सम्पूर्णमानसाः॥
en: There, on the sacred bank of the Sarasvati, the gods and the Gandharvas took their seats with gladness on account of the gratification of all their desire."

sa: वेदाध्ययनशीलानां विप्राणां साधुकर्मणाम्। पालने यत्नमातिष्ठ सर्वलोकस्य चैव ह॥
en: Do you, therefore, O Yudhishthira, try your best to protect Brahmanas of pious deeds and devoted to the study of the Vedas, as also all other men.

sa: त्रेताद्वापरयोः संधौ तदा दैवविधिक्रमात्। अनावृष्टिरभूद् घोरा लोके द्वादशवार्षिकी।॥
en: Towards the end of Treta and the commencement of Dvapara, a dreadful drought took place, extending for twelve years, in consequence of what the gods had ordained.

sa: तत्रेश्वरमयाचन्त दक्षिणार्थं मनस्वनः॥ तानब्रवीद बको दाल्भयो विभजघ्व पशूनिति॥
en: Going there, they requested the king to give them twenty one strong and healthy calves to be given away as Dakshina in the sacrifice they had finished.

sa: अत ऊर्ध्वममात्यानां परीक्षेत गुणागुणम्। संयतात्मा कृतप्रज्ञो भूतिकामश्च भूमिपः॥
en: A king who has his mind under control, who is endued with wisdom, and who seeks prosperity, should carefully examine the merits and demerits of his ministers.

sa: अष्टपादं तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्र सूचीभिरिव संवृतम्। रोमभिः संनिरुद्धाङ्गमलर्कं नाम नामतः॥
en: It had eight feet and very sharp teeth, and was covered with bristles pointed like needles. Its name was 'Alarka, its limbs were then shrunk [with fear].

sa: ततः सरथनागाश्वाः पाण्डवाः पाण्डुपूर्वज। मद्रराजं समासेदुः पीडयन्तः समन्ततः॥
en: Then the Pandavas, elder brother of Pandu, with cars and elephants and horses approached the king of the Madras and began to assail him from all sides.

sa: हतसूता हयास्तस्य रथमादाय भारत। व्यद्रवन्त दिशो राजन् हाहाकारस्तदाभवत्॥
en: Deprived of their driver the horses, of Duryodhana's car, ran wildly on all sides, O Bharata, dragging the car after them at which the Kurus bewailed loudly.

sa: तदर्जुनास्त्रं असति स्म कर्णो वियद्गतं घोरतरैः शरैस्तत्। क्रुद्धेन पार्थेन भृशाभिसृष्टं वधाय कर्णस्य महाविम॥
en: Then Karna swallowed up (destroyed) that weapon when it was flying on the sky and which Arjuna had sped with great force for the purpose of putting an end to his enemy in that fearful contest with a downpour of his own fearful arrows.

sa: लुब्धं हन्यात् सम्प्रदानेन नित्यं लुब्धस्तृप्तिं परवित्तस्य नैति। सर्वो लुब्धः कर्मगुणोपभोगे योऽर्थींनो धर्मकामौ जहाति।॥
en: A covetous man should be brought under control by continued presents. He that covetous is never satiated with taking other people's riches, Every one, however, becomes covetous of happiness. If a person, therefore, becomes destitute of wealth, he becomes shorn of virtue and pleasure.

sa: मरुद्गणा मरुत्तस्य यत् सोममपिबंस्ततः। देवान् मनुष्यान् गन्धर्वानत्यरिच्यन्त दक्षिणाः॥
en: In that sacrifice of Marutta, the Maruts drank Soma. The presents of the king excelled (in value) those ever made by the gods, the Gandharvas and men.

sa: मित्रेषु वत्सलश्चास्मि त्वद्भक्तश्च विशेषतः। तस्मादेवं पुन: साधो मय्याचरितुमर्हसि॥
en: I am devoted to the service of friends. I am, again, especially devoted to you. For these reasons, O good friend, you should reunite yourself with me.

sa: न यज्ञैर्दक्षिणावद्भिर्न तपोभिर्न विद्यया। तथा स्वर्गमुपायान्ति यथा शूरास्तनुत्यजः॥
en: By celebrating sacrifices with enough presents, by practising ascetic austerities, and by knowledge, people cannot so easily go to heaven as heroes by displaying courage in battle.

sa: ततः शास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञो बुद्धिसामर्थ्यमात्मनः।।२००। विश्राव्य पलितः प्राज्ञो बिलमन्यज्जगाम ह।
en: Having thus shown his power of understanding, the mouse Palita also, who was conve. sant with the trists of scripture and endued with wisdom, entered another hole.

sa: अकाले हि समर्थस्य स्नेहहेतुरयं तव। तस्मान्नाहं चले स्वार्थात् सुस्थिरः संधिविग्रहे॥ अभ्राणामिव रूपाणि विकुर्वन्ति क्षणे क्षणे। अद्यैव हि रिपुर्भूत्वा पुनरद्यैव मे सुहृत्॥ पुनश्च रिपुरद्यैव युक्तीनां पश्य चापलम्।
en: You are powerful. The reason which you show for your love for me now is ill-timed. Moved, however, by my own interests, I am always very strong about peace and war that are themselves very unstable. The circumstances under which peace is to be made or war declared change as speedily as the clouds change their form. This very day you were my enemy. This every day again, you becaiae my friend. This very day you have again become my enemy. Mark the considerations that move living creatures!

sa: उत्पन्ना कारणे प्रीतिरासीनौ कारणान्तरे॥ प्रध्वस्ते कारणस्थाने सा प्रीतिर्विनिवर्तते।
en: The love between us originated from an adequate cause, That cause no longer exists. On the other hand, from sufficient reasons that friendship between us has terminated,

sa: अन्योन्यस्पर्धिनौ तौ तु शरैः सन्नतपर्वभि॥ ततक्षतुस्तदाऽन्योन्यं शृङ्गाभ्यां वृषभाविव।
en: Each challenging the other, those two warriors struck each other with straight arrows in that battle, like a couple of bulls tearing cach other with their horns.

sa: यज्ञोपवीती संग्रामे जनको मैथिलो यथा। योधानुद्धर्षयामास तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर॥
en: The king of Mithila, viz., Janaka, after installation in the sacrifice of battle, pleased all his soldiers. Listen to me, O Yudhishthira, as I relate the story.

sa: विकर्षन् वै धनुः श्रेष्ठं सर्वभारसहं दृढम्॥ ज्वलनाशीविषनिभैः शरैश्चैनमवाकिरत्।
en: Drawing his best of bows capable of standing a great strain, the Panchala hero covered Ashvatthaman with arrows resembling flames of fire or snakes of virulent position.

sa: तस्मात् संस्तम्भयात्मानं श्रुतवानसि पाण्डव। देवैः पूर्वगतं मार्गमनुयातोऽसि भारत॥
en: Therefore, console yourself, O son of Pandu, for you are well read in the scriptures. You have, O Bharata, only followed the path of the very gods.

sa: तमात्तकार्मुकं दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मचारिणमव्ययम्। विव्यथे पृथिवी देवी पर्वताश्च चकम्पिरे॥
en: Seeing the illustrious Rudra arrive there dressed as a Brahmacharin and armed with that bow, the goddess Earth shrank with fear and the mountains began to shake.

sa: न पाण्डवानामस्माभिः प्रतिदेयं यथोचितम्। इति व्यवसतास्तेषु वचनं स्यान्निरर्थकम्॥
en: It has been decided among themselves that they would not give back their just dues to the sons of Pandu; and advice to them would be useless.

sa: संविच्च धार्तराष्ट्राणं सर्वेषामेव केशव। शमे प्रयतमानस्य तव सौभ्रात्रकाक्षिणः॥
en: Actuated by brotherly feelings as you are attempting to establish peace between the two parties and are seeking the good of the sons of Dhritarashtra, O Keshava.

sa: तमपश्याम संनद्धं मेघं विद्युद्युतं यथा। समन्तात् समभिध्याय हृष्यमाणोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: I beheld him, with his coat of mail on, like clouds with lightning. After thinking for a short time he addressed me thus with a light heart.

sa: कच्चिदेतैर्महादोषैर्न स्पृष्टोऽसि नराधिप। कच्चिच्च परवित्तेषु गृद्धन् न परितप्यसे।॥
en: I hope, O Lord of men, you have not been affected by any of these grave evils nor are you possessed by covetousness at other people's wealth.

sa: आढ्यानां मांसपरमं मध्यानां गोरसोत्तरम्। तैलोत्तरं दरिद्राणां भोजनं भरतर्षभ॥
en: O bull of the race of Bharata, flesh is the chief food of the rich, milk that of the middle classes and oil that of the poor.

sa: आचारः फलते धर्ममाचारः फलते धनम्। आचाराच्छ्यिमाप्नोति आचारो हन्त्यलक्षणम्॥
en: Good conduct produces virtue, good conduct produces wealth and it is from good conduct that a man attains to prosperity; and good conduct nullifies all inauspicious signs.

sa: दुरात्मना। यस्य शाखामृगा मित्राण्यक्षाः कालमुखास्तथा। जात्यन्तरगता राजन्नेतद् बुद्ध्यानुचिन्तय॥
en: Consider this, O king, by (the exercise of your) intelligence, that his (Rama's) only allies were the bears and the monkeys born in other orders of creation.

sa: ततस्ततत्वमिति ज्ञात्वा राधेयः परवीरहा। शक्तिमेवाभिकाङ्क्षन् वै वासवं प्रत्यपालयत्॥
en: Then the son of Radha, the slayer of enemies, knowing all this to be true, awaited (the arrival of) Vasava, with the desire of obtaining the dart.

sa: नारायणस्तथैवात्र भूयसोऽन्याञ्जघान ह। एवमेतौ महावीर्यौ तौ पश्यत समागतौ॥
en: In the same way Narayana has in this world killed innumerable other (Asuras); such are these two of great prowess that are seen to be united together.

sa: अनुबन्धश्च पापोऽत्र शेषश्चाप्यवशिष्यते। शेषों हि बलमासाद्य न शेषमनुशेषयेत्॥
en: In the end the result is that a surviver gives a lot of troubles and in the end collecting an army puts an end to what remains.

sa: यः स साक्षान्महादेवं गिरिशं शूलपाणिनम्। तोषयामास युद्धेन देवदेवमुमापतिम्॥
en: He who passed by his fight that god among gods, the lord of Uma-that Mahadeva himself, with the trident in his hand, that lord of the mountains.

sa: द्रौपदेयास्तथा पञ्च पञ्चालाश्चेदयस्तथा। अहं च त्वाभिषेक्ष्यामि राजानं पृथिवीपतिम्॥
en: As also the five sons of Draupadi and the princes of Panchala and Chedi and myself also anoint you as king in the lordship of the universe.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच धर्मज्ञः पण्डितो ज्ञेयो नास्तिको मूर्ख उच्यते। कामः संसारहेतुश्च हृत्तापो मत्सरः स्मृतः॥
en: Yudhishthira said : He that is versed in religion is considered as learned. He that is ignorant is called an atheist. Desire consists in a longing for the worldly objects. And what is spoken of as envy is grief is grief of the heart.

sa: यानं वस्त्रमलङ्कारं यच्चान्यत् सम्प्रयच्छति। तदेव धारयेन्नित्यमेवं प्रियतरो भवेत्॥
en: One should always use the cars, the robes, the ornaments and other things which the king bestows; and by doing this one should win the royal favour.

sa: आमन्त्र्य प्रस्थितं शौरिं रथस्थं पुरुषर्षभ। अनुजग्मुर्महेष्वासाः प्रवीरा भरतर्षभाः॥
en: Those mighty bowmen, those heroes, those foremost among the Bharatas followed that best of men, Shouri who was departing in his chariot after taking leave of them.

sa: तामुवाच महाबाहुः केशवः परिसान्त्वयन्। अचिराद् द्रक्ष्यसे कृष्णे रुदतीर्भरतस्त्रियः॥
en: Keshava with long arms then spoke these words with a view to comfort her, before long will you see, O Krishna, the ladies of Bharata's household weeping.

sa: ज्जयोऽस्तु ते पार्थिव भद्रमस्तु वः। हयेषु युक्तो नृप सम्मतः सदा तराश्वसूतो निपुणो भवाम्यहम्॥
en: That slaughterer of enemies, having approached the king addressed him thus "O king, let victory be to you and good betide you all. I am always esteemed by kings for my ability as a horse-painter. I will be an expert keeper of your horses.

sa: तौ दृष्ट्वा क्षुत्पिपासाभ्यां कृशौ भमनिसन्ततौ। शीतवातातपैश्चैव कर्शितौ पुरुषोत्तमौ॥
en: Seeing them, the best among men, emaciated with hunger and thirst, with their veins visible and afflicted with cold, wind and with the rays of the sun.

sa: सर्वेषां कुरुवृद्धानां महानयमतिक्रमः। प्रसह्य मन्दमैश्वर्ये न नियच्छत यन्नृपम्॥
en: "This is the great defeat of all the elders among the Kurus that they do not with force obstruct this wicked king in the enjoyment of prosperity.

sa: पूर्वैराचरितं यत् तत् कुराजभिररिंदमा अक्षयूतं मृगवधः कच्चिदेषां सुखावहम्॥
en: O chastiser of foes, could game at dice and the slaying of deer practised by these bad kings in the days of old be pleasant to them?

sa: एवं बहुविधैर्वाक्यैर्लक्ष्मणेन स राघवः। उक्तः प्रकृतिमापेदे कार्ये चानन्तरोऽभवत्॥
en: By these and various other words of the same significance spoken by Lakshmana, the descendant of Raghu recovered his natural calmness and became mindful of his business.

sa: स रामं सहसुग्रीवो माल्यवत्पृष्ठमास्थितम्। अभिगम्योदयं तस्य कार्यस्य प्रत्यवेदयत्॥
en: Accompanied by Sugriva he then returned to Rama who was dwelling on the plateau of the mountain Malyavana and approaching him related the success of his mission,

sa: तं प्रस्थितमभिप्रेक्ष्य भ्रातरो मनुजर्षभम्। अनुजग्मुः सहामात्या राजानश्चापि सर्वशः॥
en: His brothers, having seen him, that best among those born of Manu, go out, followed him along with the ministers and the entire body to the kings.

sa: स मन्युवशमापन्नः स्वभावं दुष्टमास्थितः। स्वभावात् पापमभ्येति तृणैश्छन्न इवोरगः॥
en: Depending on his own natural wickedness and subject to the impulse of wrath, he as if by nature, acts sinfully like a serpent hid among the grass.

sa: पुत्रस्नेहश्च बलवान् धृतराष्ट्रस्य माधव। स पुत्रवशमापन्नः प्रणिपातं प्रहास्यति॥
en: The feeling of affection for his son is stronger in Dhritarashtra, O Madhava. Subject to the will of his son, he will laugh away our respectful submission.

sa: एवमेतत् त्वया भद्रे कर्तव्यमविशङ्कया। मद्धितार्थं तथाऽऽत्मार्थं कुलार्थं चाप्यनिन्दिते॥
en: “O gentle and blameless girl, you will act in this way, without any fear, for my welfare, for your good and for the welfare of the race."

sa: मारीचश्चिन्तयामास विशिष्टान्मरणं वरम्॥ अवश्यं मरणे प्राप्ते करिष्याम्यस्य यन्मतम्।
en: Maricha then considered (within himself) "since death is certain then it is preferable at the hands of a superior being. I shall do what he (Ravana) desires."

sa: निहत्य गृध्रराजं स भिन्नाभ्रशिखरोपमम्। ऊर्ध्वमाचक्रमे सीतां गृहीत्वाङ्केन राक्षसः॥
en: Having killed that king of the vultures resembling a mountain peak penetrating through the clouds, the Rakshasa with Sita on his lap rose up (in the air).

sa: शत्रोर्मया विपन्नानां भूतानां ध्वजवासिनाम्। दिशः प्रतिष्ठमानानामस्तु शब्दो दिवंगमः॥
en: The sky will be filled with the cries of the animals placed on the enemy's flag-staff and assailed by me they will fly away in all directions.

sa: शीधीदं राज्यमद्याशु पाण्डवैरभिरक्षितम्। प्रसीद राजशार्दूल विनाशो दृश्यते महान्॥
en: Rule over this kingdom now, protected and supported by the sons of Pandu. O best among kings, rest satisfied that a great massacre is near at hand,

sa: सत्यमाहुः कर्तव्या दयास्माभिर्वनौकसाम्। साष्टमासं हि नो वर्षं यदेतदुपयुक्ष्महे॥
en: They spoke truly. We ought to have compassion for the dwellers of the forest (animals). We have been feeding on them for one year and eight months.

sa: अनित्या किल मानामर्थसिद्धिर्जयाजयौ। इति कृत्वा प्रतीक्षामि भर्तृणामुदयं पुनः॥
en: Accomplishment of purposes and victory and defeat with regard to mortals are of short duration. Thinking this, I am expecting the return of prosperity to my husbands.

sa: तयोः समभवद् युद्धं तदान्योन्यं जिगीषतोः। अतीव चित्रमाश्चर्यं शक्रप्रह्लादयोरिव॥
en: Then between those (warriors) each desirous of vanquishing the other, there took place an exceedingly wonderful battle like that (which had taken place) between Shakra and Pralhada.

sa: धर्मपाशनिबद्धेन यत् त्वया मर्षितं पुरा। तथैव बद्धमात्मानमबद्धमिव मन्यसे॥
en: If you had suffered the miseries by having been bound by the noose or morality, you are equally bound so even now though you consider yourself free.

sa: धर्मार्थयोस्तिष्ठ राजन् पाण्डवैरभिरक्षितः। न हि शक्यास्तथाभूता यत्नादपि नराधिप॥
en: Protected by the Pandavas, Oking, establish morality and earthy good. O lord of men, by every exertion in your power, allies such as they, cannot be secured.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच तस्मिन्नुत्पथमापन्ने कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः। किमुक्तवान् हृषीकेश दुर्योधनममर्पणम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said To the one who is following the wrong course, namely the wrathful Duryodhana what did the oldest among the Kurus, our grandfather, say, O Hrishikesha?

sa: तां दृष्ट्वा चारुसर्वाङ्गी यानस्थां शोककर्शिताम् मलोपचितसर्वाङ्गी जटिलां कृष्णवाससम्॥
en: And beholding her of faultless proportions, seated in the vehicle weighed down with grief, covered all over with dirt, having matted locks and wearing a dirty cloth.

sa: नुषाश्च प्रस्नुषाश्चैव धृतराष्ट्रस्य सङ्गत्ताः। हतेश्वरा नष्टपुत्रा हतनाथाश्च केशव॥
en: When the daughter-in-law and the grand daughter-in-law (wives of grandsons) of Dhritarashtra will assemble together being deprived of their protectors, their sons and their husbands, O Keshava,

sa: मारुतेन सुशीतेन सुखेनामृतगन्धिना। सेव्यमानो वने तस्मिञ्जगाम मनसा प्रियाम्॥
en: In that forest fanned by cool and pleasant breezes charged with the ordour of ambrosia, the thoughts of his dear wife crept into the mind of Rama.

sa: अन्वारुरोह दाशार्ह विदुरः सर्वधर्मवित्। सर्वप्राणभृतां श्रेष्ठं सर्वबुद्धिमतां वरम्॥
en: After that scion of the Dasharha race had mounted the car, Vidura, conversant with all virtues, superior to all living creatures and foremost among all wise men.

sa: द्वे कर्मणी नरः कुर्वन्नस्मिल्लोके विरोचते। अब्रुवन् परुषं किंचिदसतोऽनर्चयंस्तथा॥
en: By doing two things a man can attain to renown in this world by not indulging in harshness of speech and by disregarding the slightly his honest.

sa: इहैव पाण्डवाः सर्वे तथैवान्धकवृष्णयः। इहादित्याश्च रुद्राश्च वसवश्च महर्षिभिः॥
en: Here are all the Pandavas as also all the Andhakas and the Vrishnis; here are the Adityas, the Rudras and the Vasus along with the great Rishis."

sa: बालस्याश्वाः प्रियाश्चास्य करोत्यश्वांश्च मृन्मयान्। चित्रेऽपि विलिखत्यश्वांश्चित्राश्व इति चोच्यते॥
en: In his boyhood he was very fond of horses, made horses of clay and painted them. Therefore he is (sometimes) called Chitrashva (i.e. one who paints horses)

sa: चित्रः सूक्ष्मः सुकृतो यादवस्य अस्त्रे योगो वृष्णिसिंहस्य भूयान्। यथाविधं योगमाहुः प्रशस्तं सर्वैर्गुणैः सात्यकिस्तैरुपेतः॥
en: The lion of the Vrishni race, that descendant of Yadu of superior training, has many delicate and wonderful weapons. Satyaki has competent knowledge of the use of excellent arms; and he is endued with all the good qualities that are said to be good.

sa: अक्षोहिण्यो दशैका च कौरवाणां समागताः। तासां प्रमुखतो भीष्मस्तालकेतुळरोचत॥
en: Eleven Akshauhinis have assembled for the Kurus and in the foremost ranks of those is shining Bhishma who has a flag-staff as high as a palm tree.

sa: तमब्रवीज्जामदग्न्य उपेत्य मधुसूदनम्। परिष्वज्य च गोविन्दं सुरासुरपतेः सखा।॥
en: The son of Jamadagni said coming near that slayer of Madhu the friend of the lord of the gods and the Asuras had embraced Govinda and said-

sa: तेषामापततां युद्धे नापयानेऽभवन्मतिः। शीघ्रत्वमेव पार्थस्य पूजयन्ति स्म चेतसा॥
en: They who came to fight were so confounded that they even could not prepare themselves to fly away and began quickly to adore Partha in their minds.

sa: प्राज्ञस्य नृपतेराशु वृद्धिर्भवति पुत्रक। अभिवर्तति लक्ष्मीस्तं प्राचीमिव दिवाकरः॥
en: To that wise king does prosperity soon come, my dear son. The goddess of prosperity and grace comes to him like the sun coming to the east.

sa: पुत्रलोकात् पतिलोकं वृण्वानां सत्यवादिनी। प्रियान् पुत्रान् परित्यज्य पाण्डवाननुरुध्यते॥
en: That speaker of truth preferred the company of her husbands to that of her sons and leaving behind her dear sons, she follows the sons of Pandu.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं सर्वास्त्रविदुषोरस्त्रयुद्धमवर्तत। अस्त्रयुद्धे तु निर्वृत्ते शरयुद्धमवर्तत॥
en: see O Janamejaya! a battle with divine arms between Bhishma and Arjuna both experts kept on incessant for a certain time. A battle with arrows then started.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र महाबाहुमब्रवीत् कुरुसंसदि। राजन् परीतकालास्ते पुत्राः सर्वे परंतप॥
en: Said to Dhritarashtra of long arms in that assembly of the Kurus "O king, the time of all of your sons is come, O chastiser of foes.

sa: तं भीमसेनो धावन्तमभ्यधावत वीर्यवान्। त्रिगर्तराजमादातुं सिंहः क्षुद्रमृगं यथा॥
en: With a view to get hold of the king of Trigarta approaching towards him the energetic Bhimasena rushed upon him like a lion upon a small deer.

sa: एकेन रथमास्थाय पृथिवी येन निर्जिता। भीष्मद्रोणप्रभृतयः संत्रस्ताः साधुयायिनः॥
en: That Savyasachin, who alone in his car has brought the earth under his control and who inspired dared into Bhishma, Drona and others accompanied by their hosts.

sa: न लोभादर्थसम्पत्तिनराणामिह दृस्यते। तदलं तात लोभेन प्रशाम्य भरतर्षभ।॥
en: By avarice men are seen to earn prosperity in this world; therefore do you my dear son, quench this avarice of yours, O best among the Bharatas.

sa: आत्मानमेव प्रथमं द्वेष्यरूपेण योजयेत्। ततोऽमात्यानमित्रांश्च न मोघं विजिगीषते॥
